info.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Salesforce CMS Delivery API
info.description:
Delivers CMS content to external applications and headless frontends. Enables content retrieval by channel, content type, and content key for building decoupled digital experiences. Part of the Salesforce Connect REST API.

Contact Support:
 Name: Salesforce Developer Support

item.name: Salesforce Experience Cloud Query Delivery Content by Channel

query.description: (Required) Developer name of the content type (e.g., news, cms_image, cms_document, custom content types)
Language code for content variant (e.g., en_US, fr, de)
Comma-separated list of content keys to retrieve
Comma-separated list of managed content record IDs
Comma-separated list of topic names to filter content
Whether to return absolute URLs for media references
Number of items per page (default 25, max 250)
Page number (0-indexed)

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the CMS delivery channel

request.description: Retrieves published CMS content from the specified delivery channel. Returns content items matching the specified content type and optional filters. Used for headless content delivery to external applications and decoupled frontends.
